revisions.correction: Construct the Spellweave Torso as one cropped sleeved wrap jacket. Use a plain open V neckline and one continuous nearly horizontal bottom hem immediately below the waist belt. No pointed, split, dangling, or skirt-like fabric may extend beneath that line. No collar, cowl, mantle, shoulder overlay, apron, lower panel, Legs, or Boots. Show broad empty background below the hem.
